metadata.title: Internal Workflow Automation Chrome Extension
metadata.summary: Developed an internal Chrome extension to streamline support workflows and automate OTT authentication across environments, significantly improving operational efficiency and reducing repetitive manual effort.
businessImpact: Reduced login workflow time by approximately 93%
Saved around 5 minutes per environment batch
technicalChallenges: Sideloading restrictions prevented direct extension execution
Identified alternate browser execution paths to perform required API calls
Worked within environment constraints to achieve automation goals
